title: Accepted nine original-P1 controls with six synchronized existing references
raw_convention: raw, old_parsed_value and new_parsed_value are XML-parsed Android text. CH ASCII apostrophes retain exactly one Android backslash. XML-escape once on emission. Display removes Android backslash; no XML-body entity strings.

rows.confidence: Moderate authored source-supported functional wording; independent review pending.
rows.limits: The object is supplied by the shared viewport context. This repeats the meaning of the existing Show all translation without repeating its key. The Fit button also works during trim and floating-selection handling.

independent_row_findings.lexical_grammar_basis: The CNMI transitive na'annuk denotes bringing into view, not enlarging. Todu can stand for everything. Chung affirmative transitive imperatives omit agreement.
independent_row_findings.caller_basis: All three text uses invoke PaintCanvas.fit(): zoom controls, zoom-tool options, and trim options. The click wrapper only gates busy/autosaving and catches errors. fit() adjusts viewport zoom/pan, resets polygon tap bookkeeping, invalidates, and invokes status/autosave callbacks. It does not resize the bitmap or apply trim.
semantic_limits: The short label obtains its object from the active drawing viewport. It is not a command to show all application controls or files.
A functional show-everything wording rather than a technical calque of Fit.
Bounds include the full bitmap, trim rectangle and any floating selection. On too-small views fit() returns without action.

rows.backtranslation: Bring the whole canvas into view.
rows.confidence: Moderate authored source-supported functional wording; independent review pending.
rows.limits: The entire canvas is included even when the fitted bounds also contain a floating selection or trim handles. No source resizing is commanded.

independent_row_findings.backtranslation: Bring the whole canvas into view.
independent_row_findings.lexical_grammar_basis: CNMI na'annuk is visibility-oriented; todu i names the whole definite object. Brin is material canvas in the dictionary, extended here to the application drawing surface. Chung supports todu before i and an uninflected transitive imperative.
independent_row_findings.caller_basis: The exact key supplies FIT icon content description, tooltip/help wording and fit control content description. The only FIT icon invocation and all related text buttons invoke the same view-fitting method.
semantic_limits: Digital canvas is an explicitly disclosed functional extension of material brin, not an attested software sense.
Whole canvas is guaranteed to be contained in computed fit bounds, which can additionally include trim handles or a floating selection; this is not a promise to remove those objects or resize them.
No source pixel resizing, crop application, or image-to-destination scaling is commanded.

rows.backtranslation: Size of the picture in the preview (%).
rows.confidence: Moderate authored source-supported functional wording; independent review pending.
rows.limits: Size-in-preview is a functional paraphrase for the relative lens magnification setting. This labels the displayed picture, not lens frame dimensions, source dimensions or the separate main-canvas zoom. (%) and formatted=false are unchanged.

independent_row_findings.backtranslation: Size of the picture in the preview (%).
independent_row_findings.lexical_grammar_basis: CNMI mineddung is size/dimensions; pinenta is pictured/drawn content; mostra is a sample or representative part. The noun phrase makes picture content the possessor of size, with gi mostra locating it within the sample/preview. Chung supports following possessors, zero linker after consonant-final mineddung, and fused local gi with definite common nouns. The dictionary map example independently attests mineddung i followed by a possessor.
independent_row_findings.caller_basis: Both exact usages are NumericSlider controls for previewMagnification, in cursor options and showDrawingSettings(preview=true), beside the magnified drawing-preview toggle. Range 100–400 maps to factor 1–4. Drawing clips to the existing lens, scales its drawing transform by max(main zoom,1) times previewMagnification and draws the unchanged bitmap. magnifierBounds() computes frame size independently of previewMagnification.
semantic_limits: Mostra as digital preview is an authored functional extension, not a directly attested software term.
The label names size of pictured content within the preview, not size of the preview frame, source bitmap dimensions, or the main-canvas zoom slider.
The percentage is the relative lens multiplier. It is not an absolute one-source-pixel-to-screen-pixel ratio when main zoom exceeds one.

The phrase does not independently spell out the multiplier baseline; this limitation is compatible with the terse English label and both verified preview settings contexts. Do not reuse it for main-canvas zoom or bitmap resize without fresh review.
NumericSlider also uses the passed label in accessibility text and the numeric-entry dialog title. No runtime layout, glyph or accessibility behavior was exercised.

caller_semantics: ClassicPaintActivity838 is the only direct emitter across all104 production files: File menu invokes confirmReplacement {launchOpen(false)}.
confirmReplacement1074–1079 applies pending edits and either continues if clean, or offers Save/Discard/Keep editing. The label does not claim existing edits have already been saved or replaced.

launchOpen1082–1090 requests ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT/CATEGORY_OPENABLE, generic MIME */* so mislabeled valid image providers remain usable; false selects OPEN_IMAGE. launchPicker1092–1101 falls back to ACTION_GET_CONTENT and reports picker failures.

handleActivityResult1175–1187 returns without opening on cancellation;1248–1252 resolves one returned URI and sends OPEN_IMAGE to readImage(uri,false). No second use of this label imports to a floating selection.

readImage1266–1297 copies/inspects input through ImportSelection. Format/page/frame choices and resize prompts may intervene. decodeImage1310–1333 replaces the canvas on the false-import branch after successful decoding. Opening does not promise original-size loading, retained animation, pixel identity, or success.

Open image is a functional counterpart to Load image in this sole menu flow. Ellipsis remains because further choices follow. It does not mean open an existing already-selected image in place or create a blank image.
rows.confidence: Moderate own-variety source-compositional. Open-command morphology is explicit productive analogy and must be independently reviewed; no native-speaker or UI/layout certificate.

rows.backtranslation: Send the image that AN Paint has stored. [Share the already-saved image through Android’s chooser.]
caller_semantics: ClassicPaintActivity1388 is the only direct emitter: title passed to Intent.createChooser(send,ui(...)).
Save and share menu842 uses showSaveOptions(format,true,export=true);1110–1122 sets shareAfterSave and invokes chooseSaveLocation after user confirmation. Cancellation clears shareAfterSave.

writeImage1354–1372 first encodes the snapshot to a temporary images file, writes bytes to the selected destination, obtains its name, then posts Saved and calls shareSavedImage(file,format). The shared stream is the already-created encoded cache file corresponding to that write.

shareSavedImage1380–1389 builds ACTION_SEND, MIME, EXTRA_STREAM, clipData and temporary read permission, then starts Android chooser. It does not transmit to a selected recipient itself. Chooser failure says image was saved but Android could not open share.

The relative clause says the program has stored the image, not that it has sent it. The directive asks the user to send via the chooser. No extra Save command, already-transmitted claim, automatic recipient, full-current-document-saved claim, or permanent-file guarantee is introduced.

replacements.english: This image uses a colour profile that AN Paint cannot convert yet. Convert it to sRGB PNG in a colour-managed editor before importing.
replacements.old_parsed_value: Ni tlaixkopintli quitequihuía se colour profile. AN Paint ayamo hueli quitequihuía nopa colour profile para quipatlas sesen número RGB ipan ni tlaixkopintli. Achtihui xijtequihui seyoc catli ica hueli tijpatla tlaixkopintli huan catli hueli quitequihuía nopa colour profile para quipatlas sesen número RGB: ma eli número RGB ica sRGB. Xicajocui nopa tlaixkopintli (PNG). Teipa, ipan AN Paint, xijtequihui “Load image…” ica nopa PNG.
